purpose: Independent labeled precision set. Projects absent from bench/dag/manifest.json; chosen without reading any existing labels or detector code.
globalExclusions: Test directories (tests, __tests__, spec, e2e, fixtures, testing, *.test.*, *.spec.*), node_modules, .git, and findings with line < 1 (dependency or file-level, no code site). Flagged-set sources: findings, logicVulns, secrets arrays; supplyChain is not a code site.
sampling: Seeded draw (mulberry32, seed 20261026) of 60 flagged sites per language via sample.mjs, fixed before any labeling.
notes: Scan roots for strapi and nest were chosen to cover server code and exclude admin UI and framework internals; the line>=1 filter was added after a first run showed dependency-level (line 0) findings in the draw, before any labeling.
